captions: editorial annotation only; no model/tool responses replaced

segments.title: TripBudgetAI | Actual operating application
segments.text: Solo CSCI599 capstone. Five advanced features: durable memory, self-correction, human approval, iterative RAG and hybrid inference. No bookings or payments.

segments.title: 1. Local-only structured preference extraction
segments.text: This synthetic note goes to Gemma 4 E4B on this Mac. It has no cloud fallback and cannot write memory. The candidate must be reviewed and confirmed.

segments.title: 2. Explicitly confirmed long-term memory
segments.text: Only allowlisted diet, walking and category fields are saved. PostgreSQL versions the preference for this authenticated organizer and group. A process replacement comes next.

segments.title: 3. Plan, observe, critique and revise
segments.text: Four travelers, five days, NYC–PHL–DC, $850 per person. The real model proposes options; Python computes every meal, room, transfer, admission and 10% contingency.

segments.title: Actual critique and repair trace
segments.text: Inspect the durable events: retrieval/query rewrite, cloud planning, exact cost violations, a model-selected tool-validated alternative, and a successful recheck. Advisory prose cannot alter prices.

segments.title: 4. Durable human-in-the-loop pause
segments.text: This exact proposal is hash-bound, versioned and expiring. No ledger exists yet. The serving process will now terminate while this approval is pending.

segments.title: Serving process terminated
segments.text: The UI is showing its last rendered card. The process is stopped; proposal, checkpoint and confirmed preferences remain in PostgreSQL.

segments.title: Fresh process + fresh login; memory and approval restored
segments.text: The boot ID changed. The new login reloads the saved vegetarian / 6000m preference. The same pending proposal and hash return from external storage, without rerunning the models.

segments.title: Human approves the exact proposal
segments.text: Approval is an authenticated HTTP action. Commit reconstructs the plan and checks the hash, current revision, expiry and every hard constraint inside a database transaction.

segments.title: 5. Evidence-aware iterative RAG and source verification
segments.text: BGE embeddings + Chroma retrieve actual source chunks; insufficient price/schedule coverage triggers a real query rewrite. Only reviewed source snapshots support verified prices. Lodging, meals and windows remain explicit estimates.

segments.title: Guardrail edge case: impossible cap + unauthorized approval
segments.text: A $50 per-person cap cannot cover five days of mandatory meals. The request also tries to override approval. Code enforces the lower bound; user prose cannot change money or grant authority.

segments.title: Observed outcome: PROVEN INFEASIBLE
segments.text: The mandatory-cost proof stops this request. No plan is certified and no ledger is committed. Separate real retrieved-document and private-note attacks are included with full traces in the evaluation report.

segments.title: Scope and remaining limitations
segments.text: Planning estimates are not ticket availability or accessibility guarantees. Real model/provider failures are retained in the report. The app does not book, pay, email or execute arbitrary code. Source, tests, traces and deployment recipe accompany this recording.
